title: Intent cues reviewed; phone overlap and size budget corrected
summary: The first blade was too narrow and the gallery PNGs exceeded budget. A wider diagonal blade, compact cues and lossless WebP resolved those issues; phone shortcuts no longer cover combat. Author reviewed 32/64 px, desktop and phone views. Focused browser checks: 7/7; five-game smoke: 5/5. Full app gate: 558 passes, 3 five-second timeouts; unchanged baseline reproduces the Hearth timeout. Gameplay testing is pending.

title: Spire intent-cue pilot and independent review gallery
summary: Six action symbols, exact next-action text, and a visible target marker. Matched combat captures and independent comparisons are prepared for review.
